blocks.en:
In this subsection, we show that certain imbeddings involving Sobolev spaces are compact. This is often useful in applications since it implies that certain sequences have convergent subsequences; the limit of such a subsequence is typically the solution that is being sought. It is also useful in defining certain equivalent norms for Sobolev spaces as we do at the end of this subsection.

We begin with the definition of a compact imbedding.
blocks.zh:
本小节证明涉及 Sobolev 空间的某些嵌入是紧的. 这在应用中往往很有用, 因为它表明某些序列具有收敛子序列; 这种子序列的极限通常就是所求的解. 紧性也有助于定义 Sobolev 空间的某些等价范数, 本小节末尾就将这样做.

先定义紧嵌入.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X,Y$ be Banach spaces such that $X$ is continuously imbedded in $Y$. We say that $X$ is \textbf{compactly imbedded} in $Y$ and write\[X\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}Y\]if the unit ball in $X$ is precompact in $Y$ or, equivalently, every bounded sequence in $X$ has a subsequence that converges in $Y$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X,Y$ 为 Banach 空间, 且 $X$ 连续嵌入 $Y$. 若 $X$ 中的单位球在 $Y$ 中预紧, 或等价地, $X$ 中每个有界序列都有在 $Y$ 中收敛的子序列, 则称 $X$ \textbf{紧嵌入} $Y$, 记为\[X\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}Y\]
blocks.label: def:compact-imbedding

blocks.en: We now prove one of the most basic compact imbedding theorems.
blocks.zh: 现在证明一个最基本的紧嵌入定理.

blocks.en: Let $k>m/2$ and let $\Omega$ be bounded and such that it has the $k$-extension property. Then\[H^k(\Omega)\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}C_b(\overline\Omega),\]i.e., $H^k(\Omega)$ is compactly imbedded in $C_b(\overline\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: 设 $k>m/2$, $\Omega$ 有界且具有 $k$ 阶延拓性质. 那么\[H^k(\Omega)\overset{c}{\hookrightarrow}C_b(\overline\Omega),\]即 $H^k(\Omega)$ 紧嵌入 $C_b(\overline\Omega)$.
blocks.label: thm:sobolev-continuous-target-compact-embedding

blocks.en: The theorem follows immediately from the Sobolev imbedding theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-full-space-continuous-embedding}), Lemma~\ref{lem:sobolev-holder-continuity}, and the Arzela-Ascoli theorem (Theorem~\ref{thm:arzela-ascoli}).
blocks.zh: 由 Sobolev 嵌入定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:sobolev-full-space-continuous-embedding}), Lemma~\ref{lem:sobolev-holder-continuity} 及 Arzela-Ascoli 定理 (Theorem~\ref{thm:arzela-ascoli}) 立即得到本定理.

blocks.en: The assumption that $\Omega$ is bounded is essential. To see this let $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^m$ and consider the sequence of translated functions\[u_n(\bm{x})=u(\bm{x}+n\bm{e}),\]where $\bm{e}$ is any fixed unit vector and $u$ any nonzero element of $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$. This sequence is, of course, bounded in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$. However, the sequence can have no uniformly convergent subsequence. (To prove this, one needs to show that no such sequence that does converge uniformly can be in $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ because of its behavior at infinity.)
blocks.zh: $\Omega$ 有界的假设是必不可少的. 为说明这一点, 令 $\Omega=\mathbb{R}^m$, 并考察平移函数序列\[u_n(\bm{x})=u(\bm{x}+n\bm{e}),\]其中 $\bm{e}$ 为任意固定单位向量, $u$ 为 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 的任意非零元素. 当然, 该序列在 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中有界. 然而, 该序列不可能有一致收敛子序列. (为证明这一点, 需要由无穷远处的行为说明, 任何这样确实一致收敛的序列都不可能属于 $H^k(\mathbb{R}^m)$.)
blocks.label: ex:unbounded-domain-translated-functions-noncompactness
